query: SELECT repository_id, SUM(db.size_bytes)::BIGINT AS total_bytes FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT dm.package_repository_id AS repository_id, dmb.blob_digest FROM docker_manifests dm JOIN docker_manifest_blobs dmb ON dmb.manifest_id = dm.id WHERE dm.package_repository_id = ANY($1) ) distinct_blobs JOIN docker_blobs db ON db.digest = distinct_blobs.blob_digest GROUP BY repository_id
